item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 17/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Talim will move across the vicinity of Beibu Wan tomorrow, moving into the inland areas of Guangxi and weakening gradually. However, its associated rainbands will still bring squally showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea, there will still be showers over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. An anticyclone aloft will strengthen towards the weekend and the weather will improve slightly over Guangdong. The area of low pressure now over the western North Pacific is expected to develop into a tropical cyclone. It may enter the northern part of the South China Sea early next week and bring unsettled weather to the region.
